text_block_list.text:
On their day off, Winning Ticket and the 
Trainer went to watch the races.

Each putting their own hopes on the line, 
the Umamusume run desperately. Deeply 
moved by that race, she passionately vows 
to give it her all as well.

However... contrary to her feelings, 
Winning Ticket continued to struggle with 
her plateau.
